use IO.Std.write
use default

use Sequence = (int) -> int
use Maker = (Sequence[]) -> Sequence

class SELF_APPLY(_f: (SELF_APPLY) -> Sequence[]) is
    apply(r: SELF_APPLY) -> Sequence[] => _f(r)
si

fix_star(makers: Maker[]) -> Sequence[] =>
    let wrap =
        SELF_APPLY(
            r =>
                makers
                    |> map((make: Maker) -> Sequence =>
                            (n: int) => make(r.apply(r))(n))
                    |> collect_array())
    in wrap.apply(wrap)

show(label: string, f: Sequence) is
    write(label)

    for n in 0..21 do
        write(" {f(n)}")
    od

    write_line()
si

let hofstadter = fix_star([
    (fs: Sequence[]) =>
        (n: int) => if n == 0 then 1 else n - fs[1](fs[0](n - 1)) fi,
    (fs: Sequence[]) =>
        (n: int) => if n == 0 then 0 else n - fs[0](fs[1](n - 1)) fi
])

show("F:", hofstadter[0])
show("M:", hofstadter[1])
